answer: Marble-veined work ledger: each finished job is stamped with a pigment marble pattern derived from the paying client's secret nonce, so no two outputs share one vein. A new identity earns only after three unrelated clients each co-sign one marble-stamped job; its bond is 6 POA times the square of its position among identities from one wallet (1st 6, 10th 600, 2,310 POA across ten). A fake that tries to wander between wallets cannot reuse one client's marble, and a copied vein is public proof of fraud.
